## Co-instructor

### BIOS 605 · Introduction to SAS Statistical Programming

**University of Michigan · Fall 2019**

I taught SAS programming and data manipulation to first-year master's students and graded homework and final projects.

## Graduate student instructor

### BIOS 620 · Introduction to Health Data Science

**University of Michigan · Winter 2021 & Winter 2024**

I guided student-designed group projects that applied federated learning and distributed computing to personal-device screen-time data collected throughout the semester. I also held weekly office hours and graded homework and examinations.

### BIOS 626 · Machine Learning for Health Sciences

**University of Michigan · Winter 2021**

I supported students through weekly office hours and graded homework and examinations.

## Research mentoring

**SPIN project · 2025–2026**

I mentored three master's students in Biostatistics at the University of Michigan—Suyuan Wang, Tong Liu, and Haowen Wu—providing hands-on implementation guidance through regular remote meetings. Suyuan subsequently entered the Ph.D. program in Biostatistics at the Medical College of Wisconsin.

## Scientific community

**Organizer, Spatial Working Group · Dana-Farber Cancer Institute · 2026–present**

I organize monthly meetings for researchers at Dana-Farber and Harvard who work on or are interested in spatial omics. Our meetings bring researchers together to exchange methods, discuss computational tools and analytical challenges, and share ongoing work.
